performance.verdict: Lead collapse is confirmed real; 5 overdue SOW milestones now threaten the renewal decision.

findings.text: CPL exploded 811.75% in 7d — last 6 series days show 0 leads (Sep 10–15) vs 3–6/day prior. Confirmed delivery failure, not noise.
5 milestones overdue: dashboard, phone-match attribution, CRM cleanup, and renewal scoreboard — all past August 31 deadline with no completion event.
GHL shows 81 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days — leads are arriving but converting to nothing; intake pipeline is leaking, not an ads problem.
3-day signal (Sep 13–15): spend averaged $19.14/day but leads = 0 across all 3 days, vs prior 3 days (Sep 10–12) also 2 leads total — zero-result window is now 6 days long.
GBP actions fell 46.67% WoW and show 0 on Sep 13–15 in series; organic reinforcement is gone exactly when paid collapsed, compounding lead drought.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore Meta campaign delivery on BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness — 6 consecutive zero-lead days confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign ($366.13 of 28-day spend) produced 0 leads across Sep 10–15 despite spend running on some days. Check campaign status, audience size, ad rejections, and budget pacing inside Meta Ads Manager immediately. Success is defined as at least 3 leads/day returning within 3 days of the fix. Re-check on Sep 19.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer — dashboard and attribution gap are blocking the stay/walk renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones passed their deadlines with no completion event: phone-match attribution (Aug 7), CRM cleanup (Aug 14), dashboard live (Aug 31), and the August scoreboard trusted for renewal (Aug 31). The client's stated scoreboard — leads to scheduled to shown to new patients — cannot be read without the dashboard and attribution gap closed. Nacer to confirm owner and hard delivery date for each item by Sep 18; success is all 5 marked complete with evidence before the next client check-in.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery — 0 on Sep 13–15; if still below 5/day by Sep 19, escalate to GBP team.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 46.67% WoW and hit 0 on the last 3 logged days (Sep 13–15), removing organic reinforcement at the worst possible time. No action is taken now because the cause is not yet isolatable from the Meta collapse. Re-check on Sep 19: if GBP actions remain below 5/day, escalate to the GBP team as a separate issue. No paid budget should move until Meta delivery is restored.
